notes.title: Added creatures, changed transformation specifications
notes.notes:
■ Added 9 new creatures
- Localization for these new creatures is not yet complete.
■ Transformation Changes
- Items are now consumed to undo transformations.
- Items required for transformation are now consumed.
- Several changes have been made to creature transformation routes.
■ Creature HP has been increased overall.

notes.title: Some English translation corrections
notes.notes: Also fixed the red text at the top of the screen.

notes.title: Halved capacity, atmosphere change, experience points related
notes.notes: The game's capacity has been compressed by about 54%. We have tweaked the atmosphere of the game. Fixed a situation where the user would not gain experience points if they were killed by an indirect attack.

notes.title: Close right side when save data exists
notes.notes: When there is save data, the passage on the right side is closed at the start of the game.

notes.title: Fixed behavior when playing again from the beginning.
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where if you had saved data and you dived through the ship to start from the beginning, you would start with the character you had saved.

notes.title: 05/29　Fixed some characters and stages.
notes.notes:
・Fixed an issue where some characters would not perform attacks even when pressing the attack button.
・Fixed an issue where some bosses were killed automatically.

notes.title: Hexanchus and aquatic creature behavior fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed the detection around Hexanchus and ship doors, so they should now be able to enter and exit normally.
Fixed the behavior of aquatic creatures entering and exiting water at high speeds, or becoming airborne through repeated collisions.

notes.title: Fixed problems with some characters
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where some characters would be unable to move after attacking.

notes.title: First Area Fix
notes.notes: Prevented an infinite fall after passing through an invisible wall in the prologue area.

notes.title: Changed the interior of the sunken ship
notes.notes: The interior of the sunken ship has been changed since the floor was too thin and the walking on the floor function was not compatible. The difficulty has not changed.

notes.title: Prevents inertia from working during conversations
notes.notes:
- Inertia no longer works during conversations, causing characters to continue moving.
- Fixed some characters that were not compatible with certain controllers.

notes.title: Sufficient space is now required for the change.
notes.notes:
- To deal with slipping through terrain, a sufficient amount of space is now required to transform. Transforming is difficult not only in narrow spaces, but also in terrain like grooves. It will also be difficult if you are in contact with an enemy.
-Fixed the issue where you could have conversations with the menu open.
-Added some dialogue content.

notes.title: Fixes to conversations, choices, the behavior of some characters, and cameras.
notes.notes:
Options are now highlighted on the selection screen.
Unnecessary processing has been removed from conversations.
Fixed processing that caused Archaeplastida to not stop when using its special move.
Changed the camera collision issue when approaching in the early stages.

notes.title: Corrected the processing of some characters.
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where Cladoselache and FrillShark would switch to CPU behavior when attacked.

notes.title: Fixing unintended behavior
notes.notes: Changed the processing after boarding the escape pod in the prologue.
